Delicious food, a bit pricey
Mar 2018 • Couples
We went to Sakura Deli before we took a night train to Hanoi from Lao Cai. It is 10 minutes walk from Lao Cai train station and a good place for dinner before getting on a night train. The service is fast and the staff is kind. The food is delicious including the cold starters and salads. The sushi was the most fresh one I ate during our Vietnam trip. The only small problem is the prices. The interior design and the food you get already give you an idea that it is not a cheap-eat however considering the fact that the place is in Lao Cai where people only use it as a stopover to Sapa, they can lower the prices a bit considering Vietnam standards. Apart from that the food you get is classy. They serve Japanese beer also..
